sources.label: SoftBank acquisition of Berkshire Grey announcement

profile_text.body:
Berkshire Grey is a Bedford, Massachusetts company founded in 2013 that, in its own words, provides AI-powered robotic automation solutions for warehouse, ecommerce, retail, and 3PL logistics operations. The company describes its offerings as physical AI warehouse automation intended to accelerate fulfillment, reduce operating costs, and scale with a business.

Its site names one product, Stride, described as a shuttle sorting system that handles a wide range of item types using autonomous shuttles and intelligent routing to automate sorting with reliable, scalable throughput.

The company's acquisition by SoftBank was announced in May 2023, per a SoftBank press release. Massachusetts is recorded as a jurisdiction of legal exposure, with 191 cases.
